flags.message: The staged November 12 snapshot labels the lower tribunal United States Bankruptcy Appellate Panel for the 10th Circuit, No. 26-2404. The staged application instead expressly arises from the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit, identifies Fourth Circuit No. 26-2404, and seeks preservation while that court considers rehearing. Review/correct the upstream lower-court metadata. This discrepancy does not prevent scoring the recorded November 11 denial.
